subject: Future Tech
title: The Next Nano Decade
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Next Nano Decade usable.

hook.text: By 2035, the nanotech market is projected to hit $300 billion.

buildup.text: Nano-enabled cancer vaccines, water purifiers, and flexible electronics are already in trials.

discovery.text: Convergence is the key trend: nano + AI + biotech creates systems impossible with any single field alone.

climax.text: Nations are racing for nano-leadership. China, the US, and EU invest billions.

punchline.text: The future is nanoscale. The race to master it has already begun.

quiz.question: What is the projected nanotech market size by 2035?
